in_sanskrit.name: Baadshah
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord, King
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Baadshah एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Baadshah is a title of respect for a king or a ruler. The name is derived from Urdu, Persian, and Turkish languages, and is commonly used in the Indian subcontinent. The name signifies power, authority, and leadership.
